title: feat(flow designer): the publish checks show before the publish, worded for the builder
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgae1jRRi8FRrTxaZL

Part of #34818 (slice 1 of 3: items 1 and 2; slice 2 takes items 3 and 4, slice 3 items 5 to 9 and closes the card).

Clause-②: yes (widening: optional userTextLocales on GetMetaItemRequestSchema)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `userTextLocales` is a request field the REST door and the runtime dispatcher set from the request's locale; no metadata author writes it, so there is nothing for a skill to teach

## 维护者速读

- 流程草稿的读取现在带上发布检查会报的建议：条件分支没设条件、审批人可能为空这类，保存后就进「问题」页签，点一条能定位到节点。
- 检查文字改为面向搭建者：用流程和节点的显示名，没有规则号、`node_3`、`xin_huiyi_tixing`，11 种语言都有译文。
- 发布抽屉在「全部发布」上方按流程列出这些检查；从抽屉或设计器发布后，提示只留一句标题。
- AI 等未经检查列表的发布路径仍保留完整提示，因为那是作者唯一能看到这些检查的地方。
- 契约面：`GetMetaItemRequestSchema` 新增可选 `userTextLocales`（只放宽，记为 `Metadata-protocol: added`，spec 升 minor）；规则、严重级别和发布判定都不变。
- 已知偏差：「了解更多」里的规则号未做，它需要在 `_diagnostics.warnings[]` 上加 `code`，本卡不做这个扩展（席位裁定）。

## What changes

**Server: a flow draft read carries what its publish would still report.**
- `draftPublishJudgement` (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts`) returns the publish gate's refusals and its advisories. `draftPublishVerdict` keeps its shape for its callers.
- `serveDraft` (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`) folds the advisories into the draft's `_diagnostics.warnings` through `withPublishAdvisories` (`metadata-diagnostics.ts`). Each warning has an item-relative path (`nodes.1`) and the finding's `userMessage`, else its `message`. Warnings are deduplicated on path and message, and `valid` is not changed. Only `flow` drafts are folded (`DRAFT_ADVISORY_TYPES`), so other types' draft reads are unchanged.
- The locale for the sentence comes from the request: `GetMetaItemRequestSchema.userTextLocales` (new, optional, at most 2), set from `userTextLocalesOf(ctx)` by the REST item read (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`, draft reads only) and the runtime dispatcher (`domains/meta.ts`). Absent means English.

**Lint: the two flow findings speak to the builder.**
- `flow-decision-unconditional-branch` gets a user-text catalog (`lint-flow-patterns.user-text.ts`) in all 11 platform locales, with two arms: `none` (no path is gated) and `mixed` (some paths are not gated). It names the flow, the branch step and the target steps by label, says what the shape does to a run, and says how to fix it. Its findings now carry `path` (`flows[i].nodes[j]`) and `userTextParams`.
- The `approval-approvers-*` sentences take the flow's and the node's labels (`flowDisplayLabel`, `flowNodeLabel`) instead of the flow's machine name and the node id. With no label they fall back to the name or id.
- Rules, severities, `message`, `hint` and `where` are unchanged.

**Console: the checks before the publish.**
- The designer's Problems tab already lists a draft's `_diagnostics.warnings` and maps `nodes.N` to that node. With the server change, the checks appear there after each save, and the tab's count includes them. No designer code changed for this.
- The pending-changes drawer (`DraftChangesPanel.tsx`) reads each flow draft through `readDraftChecks` (`preview/flowDraftChecks.ts`). The read sends the console language as `Accept-Language`. The drawer lists the checks above Publish, grouped under the flow's label, and in Studio the label opens that flow. The drawer never disables Publish, and a failed read lists nothing. It uses one new eager pack key, `preview.changes.flowChecksTitle`, in all 11 packs.
- After a publish made from the drawer or the designer while the checks were listed, the advisory toast keeps its title line only (`providers/saveAdvisoryToast.ts`, `preview/publishChecksShown.ts`). The mark lasts only while that publish is in flight. Any other publish (an AI surface, or an item the drawer listed nothing for) keeps the full toast. That is pinned by the existing `*AdvisoryReachesAuthor` suites, which stay green.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.test.ts`:
  - the new catalog is pinned and rendered from real findings, both arms, in every locale;
  - the path is `flows[0].nodes[1]`;
  - no machine names or rule id appear in any locale;
  - the fallback to machine names when there are no labels;
  - approval sentences carry labels while `where` is unchanged.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (#34818 describe):
  - zh warning at `nodes.1` with `valid: true`;
  - English with no locale;
  - the warning equals the judgement advisory's `userMessage`;
  - a gated decision reads no warning.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.publish-advisories.test.ts`: `withPublishAdvisories` unit pins.
- `ui/.../preview/flowDraftChecks.test.ts`: projection, flow-only reads, `Accept-Language`, failed reads.
- `ui/.../preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.flowChecks-34818.test.tsx`:
  - the block lists the sentence under the label;
  - the Publish button stays live;
  - the block is silent when there are no checks;
  - the reviewed mark holds only for the flight, with a control.
- `ui/.../providers/saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts` (#34818 describe): title-only after a reviewed publish, with three controls (unreviewed publish, save door, another item).

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD and verified):
- Replacing the `withPublishAdvisories` call with `const after = refused;` fails 3 of the 4 new protocol tests. The 4th ("gated decision reads no warning") stays green, as expected.
- Making `listedBeforePublish` return `false` fails 1 of 22 toast tests (the title-only case).
- Stubbing the drawer's `readDraftChecks` call fails 3 of 5 drawer tests. "Says nothing" and the CONTROL stay green, as expected.

## Acceptance notes

The card's acceptance lines covered by this slice:
- **"发布前「问题」页签列出条件分支没有条件、审批人可能解析为空这两条，点击能定位节点；发布抽屉里也看得到"**
  - Server half: measured by the protocol tests.
  - Designer half: the existing mapping in `buildFlowProblems` (`serverTarget`, `nodes.N` to node).
  - Drawer: the drawer suite.
- **"两条的文字里没有 `node_2`、`xin_huiyi_tixing`、规则号和英文段落"**: lint suite, all 11 locales.

Bound: once the publish lands, the published read does not run the publish gate. So the Problems tab lists these advisories again only after the next save makes a new draft.

Accepted deviation (seat ruling in the thread): no rule id under a "learn more" line. It needs `code` on `_diagnostics.warnings[]`, a spec widening this slice does not make.

## Verification

Measured on head `762fafa44` (base `3bbda33b`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on a shared box:

- Tests:
  - `@objectstack/lint`: 7 affected files, 513 passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: full suite, 349 files, 23098 passed.
  - `@objectstack/rest`: full suite, 420 files.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: `src/domains/meta`, 45 files, 2616 passed.
  - `ui/`: `packages/app-shell/src/preview/`, `providers/`, `console/ai/__tests__/`, the advisory sink suites and `packages/i18n/`, 246 files, 2984 passed. All exit 0.
- Type-check: exit 0 for spec, lint, metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (both projects).
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --ran`, 125 derived, 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - Two were red and are fixed in this branch: `check:facade-delegation-only` (the protocol facade was 1 line over its ceiling) and `check:test-source-alias` (the new advisory test now loads the lint package during collection).
  - Three exited 3 until their prerequisites were met, then exited 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (after fetching its pinned commit), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (after the full build that `check:type-check-debt` runs).
- Changeset level: `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, run locally with this body as the event payload. It refused `Metadata-protocol: none` because `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` gains `api/GetMetaItemRequest:userTextLocales`. The body and the changeset therefore declare `added` with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`.
- Eager locale bundle: console `vite build` with `CI=true`. The before leg is this head with only `locales/en.ts` restored to base.
  - `i18n-locale-en`: 61,622 to 61,648 bytes gzip (+26), against the 62,000 ceiling, so 352 bytes of headroom.
  - Eager closure total: 1,941,502 to 1,941,499 bytes gzip.
  - `check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`: exit 0 on both legs.
- Not run locally, left to CI: `test:repo`, the dogfood battery (no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm), and the full ui suite. No browser check of the running console was taken for this slice.
